id: 08_what's the difference b w biosafety & biosecurity microbiology laboratory biosaf
title: 生物安全与生物安保：防意外，也防故意
source_doc: course/Microbiology Biosafety/08_what's the difference b w biosafety & biosecurity microbiology laboratory biosaf.md
author_source: project/Microbiology Biosafety/08_what's the difference b w biosafety & biosecurity microbiology laboratory biosaf/src.py

points.K5: 生物安全：防止意外释放
points.K6: 生物安保：防止故意滥用
points.K7: 生物安全护的是人和环境
points.K8: 生物安保护的是设施和材料
points.K12: 一句话区别：意外与故意
points.S1: 中文“生物安全”，两层意思
points.S3: 风险评估，也评安保风险

shots.scene: 欣欣站在实验室门口，一手举盾牌一手举锁
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands at a lab door holding a shield icon in one paw and a padlock icon in the other, and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 这一课分清生物安全和生物安保。
overlay: 生物安全与生物安保：防意外，也防故意

shots.scene: 盾牌和锁两个图标并排
shots.prompt_en: A shield icon and a padlock icon side by side. No people.
shots.narration: 一个防意外，一个防故意。

shots.scene: 阿杰下课把门卡借给同学，门开着就走了
shots.prompt_en: The young male student hands his access card to another student and leaves the lab door propped open.
shots.narration: 阿杰图方便，把门卡借人，门也没关。

shots.scene: 小研戴着手套操作时把培养瓶碰倒
shots.prompt_en: In another room, the female graduate student in gloves accidentally knocks over a culture flask in a biosafety cabinet.
shots.narration: 同一天，小研不小心碰倒了培养瓶。

shots.scene: 欣欣站在两幅画面中间
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands between two framed pictures: an open door and a tipped flask.
shots.narration: 这两件事，哪件是安全，哪件是安保？

shots.scene: 两个标题牌并排，中间一个问号
shots.prompt_en: Two blank title boards side by side with a question mark between them. No people.
shots.narration: 两个词听起来很像，

shots.scene: 盾牌和锁共同围住一个样本管
shots.prompt_en: A shield and a padlock together surround a sample tube with a biohazard warning sign. No people.
shots.narration: 都和生物材料的安全操作、

shots.scene: 样本管在保存、使用、管理三个图标间流转
shots.prompt_en: A sample tube moves through three icons: a storage freezer, a lab bench and a logbook. No people.
shots.narration: 防护和管理有关。

shots.scene: 两条分开的箭头，指向不同方向
shots.prompt_en: Two arrows starting from the same point and pointing in different directions. No people.
shots.narration: 但关注点和目标不一样。

shots.scene: 两个相交的圆，中间是一个宝箱
shots.prompt_en: Two overlapping circles with a treasure chest icon in the overlap. No people.
shots.narration: 可以把生物材料看成要守护的宝贝。

shots.scene: 左圆里四个图标
shots.prompt_en: The left circle shows four icons: a containment box, a checklist, goggles and gloves, and a waste bin. No people.
shots.narration: 安全这边：防护、规范、设备和废物管理。

shots.scene: 右圆里三个图标
shots.prompt_en: The right circle shows three icons: a padlock, a control panel and a signed logbook. No people.
shots.narration: 安保这边：保护、控制和问责。

shots.section_title: 生物安全：防止意外释放
shots.scene: 实验室里样本管封好，向外的箭头被挡住
shots.prompt_en: A sealed sample tube inside a lab outline; an arrow trying to leave the lab is blocked by a wall. No people.
shots.narration: 生物安全，是一整套操作和防护，
overlay: 生物安全：防止意外释放

shots.section_title: 生物安全：防止意外释放
shots.scene: 小研在生物安全柜里规范操作
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student works carefully in a biosafety cabinet in a lab coat, gloves and goggles.
shots.narration: 防止有害生物材料意外跑出实验室。

shots.section_title: 生物安保：防止故意滥用
shots.scene: 冷冻柜被锁住，一只伸来的手被挡开
shots.prompt_en: A locked freezer; a reaching hand icon is blocked by a padlock. No people.
shots.narration: 生物安保，防的是有人故意乱用、
overlay: 生物安保：防止故意滥用

shots.section_title: 生物安保：防止故意滥用
shots.scene: 偷拿、冒用门卡两个图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a hand taking a tube from a freezer and a borrowed access card, each crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 偷拿，或者没授权就接触，

shots.section_title: 生物安保：防止故意滥用
shots.scene: 通用警示图标：被打叉的危害符号
shots.prompt_en: A generic danger symbol inside a red prohibition circle. No people.
shots.narration: 被拿去做坏事，包括生物恐怖。

shots.section_title: 生物安全护的是人和环境
shots.scene: 人、环境、人群三个图标被盾牌护住
shots.prompt_en: A shield covering three icons: a lab worker, a landscape and a crowd of people. No people.
shots.narration: 生物安全首先保护实验人员，
overlay: 生物安全护的是人和环境

shots.section_title: 生物安全护的是人和环境
shots.scene: 盾牌延伸到实验楼外的社区
shots.prompt_en: The shield expands from the lab building to the neighborhood around it. No people.
shots.narration: 也保护周围环境和公众，不受暴露。

shots.section_title: 生物安保护的是设施和材料
shots.scene: 锁住的实验楼、冷冻库和资料柜
shots.prompt_en: A padlock icon over a lab building, a freezer room and a records cabinet. No people.
shots.narration: 生物安保保护实验室、研究设施，
overlay: 生物安保护的是设施和材料

shots.section_title: 生物安保护的是设施和材料
shots.scene: 设施周围一圈防护线
shots.prompt_en: A protective ring drawn around the lab building and its utilities. No people.
shots.narration: 和相关设备设施，防范外来威胁。

shots.scene: 四个图标：培训、设备、防护设施、规程
shots.prompt_en: Four icons: a training class, a biosafety cabinet, a containment lab door and a blank procedure book. No people.
shots.narration: 生物安全靠四样东西：

shots.scene: 王老师给阿杰和小研上培训课
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator gives a training session to the young male student and the female graduate student.
shots.narration: 培训、设备、设施和规程，降低风险。

shots.scene: 门禁读卡器和限制进入标识
shots.prompt_en: An access card reader beside a lab door with a no-entry-for-unauthorized-persons pictogram. No people.
shots.narration: 生物安保靠门禁，限制进入，

shots.scene: 上锁的冷冻柜和空白登记本
shots.prompt_en: A locked freezer next to a blank inventory logbook. No people.
shots.narration: 材料锁好存放，

shots.scene: 保卫处值班员核对人员名单
shots.prompt_en: The security officer checks a blank staff list at a desk.
shots.narration: 进入人员要审核，

shots.scene: 小研对着登记本清点冻存盒
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student counts cryo boxes against the inventory logbook.
shots.narration: 高风险材料要有账可查。

shots.scene: 四扇实验室门，防护图标逐级增加
shots.prompt_en: Four lab doors in a row, each with more shield icons than the last. No people.
shots.narration: 实验室按防护要求分为四级，

shots.scene: 从一级到四级的箭头越来越粗
shots.prompt_en: An arrow below the doors grows thicker from the first door to the fourth. No people.
shots.narration: 从一级到四级，控制越来越严。

shots.scene: 两排台阶方向相反
shots.prompt_en: Two staircases side by side with danger arrows pointing in opposite directions. No people.
shots.narration: 注意：国内病原分类第一类最危险，

shots.scene: 欣欣指着国内一侧台阶
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot points to the top step of the right-hand staircase.
shots.narration: 和国际分组方向相反，别记反。

shots.section_title: 一句话区别：意外与故意
shots.scene: 左边倒下的培养瓶，右边伸手偷拿
shots.prompt_en: Split screen: on the left a tipped culture flask, on the right a hand sneaking a tube from a freezer. No people.
shots.narration: 一句话：生物安全防意外，
overlay: 一句话区别：意外与故意

shots.section_title: 一句话区别：意外与故意
shots.scene: 右侧画面配一个锁
shots.prompt_en: The right side of the split screen is covered by a padlock icon. No people.
shots.narration: 生物安保防故意。

shots.section_title: 一句话区别：意外与故意
shots.scene: 欣欣指回情景里的两幅画
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot points back to the two pictures: the tipped flask and the open door.
shots.narration: 瓶子碰倒是安全，门卡借人是安保。

shots.scene: 三个咬合的齿轮在转动
shots.prompt_en: Three interlocking gears turning: yellow, red and green. No people.
shots.narration: 人人有安全和安保意识，

shots.scene: 绿色大齿轮带动地球图标
shots.prompt_en: The large green gear turns a globe icon. No people.
shots.narration: 风险管理才有效，最终守护大众健康。

shots.scene: 盾牌和锁拼成一个完整的圆
shots.prompt_en: A shield and a padlock join to form a complete circle around a sample tube. No people.
shots.narration: 生物安全和安保，缺一不可。

shots.scene: 科研、医疗、教学三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: a research microscope, a hospital cross and a classroom. No people.
shots.narration: 科研、医疗还是教学，都一样。

shots.scene: 天平：收益一端高，风险一端低
shots.prompt_en: A balance scale where the benefits side outweighs the risks side. No people.
shots.narration: 两者做好，收益才能大于风险。

shots.section_title: 中文“生物安全”，两层意思
shots.scene: 王老师举着空白封面的法律文本
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator holds up a law book with a blank cover.
shots.narration: 中文里的生物安全，是个大概念。
overlay: 中文“生物安全”，两层意思

shots.section_title: 中文“生物安全”，两层意思
shots.scene: 大圆里套着盾牌和锁两个小圆
shots.prompt_en: A large circle containing two smaller circles: one with a shield and one with a padlock. No people.
shots.narration: 生物安全法既管实验室生物安全，

shots.section_title: 中文“生物安全”，两层意思
shots.scene: 大圆里还有防范生物威胁的盾牌
shots.prompt_en: Inside the large circle, a third small circle with a generic shield against a crossed-out threat icon. No people.
shots.narration: 也管防范生物恐怖等安保问题。

shots.section_title: 中文“生物安全”，两层意思
shots.scene: 实验室门上同时贴盾牌和锁的标识
shots.prompt_en: A lab door with both a biohazard warning sign and a padlock pictogram. No people.
shots.narration: 实验室里常把后者叫生物安保。

shots.section_title: 中文“生物安全”，两层意思
shots.scene: 空白文件盖章图标
shots.prompt_en: A blank document with a stamp icon. No people.
shots.narration: 具体要求，以现行文本为准。

shots.scene: 走廊里一个陌生人在门口张望
shots.prompt_en: A shadowy unfamiliar figure icon peers through a lab door window at the end of a corridor. No people.
shots.narration: 看到陌生人在实验室附近徘徊，

shots.scene: 地上一个来历不明的空白包裹
shots.prompt_en: An unmarked blank package left on the floor of a lab corridor. No people.
shots.narration: 或者来历不明的包裹，

shots.scene: 小研站远处，不碰包裹
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student keeps her distance from the package with her hands raised away.
shots.narration: 不靠近、不拆、不碰。

shots.scene: 小研打电话，保卫处值班员接听
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student makes a phone call; the security officer answers at the campus security desk.
shots.narration: 报告负责人和保卫处，必要时报警。

shots.scene: 老周拿着空白清单，冷冻柜旁画问号
shots.prompt_en: The older man holds a blank inventory list next to a freezer with a question mark icon.
shots.narration: 材料对不上账，也要马上报告。

shots.section_title: 风险评估，也评安保风险
shots.scene: 小研填写风险评估表，表上有盾牌和锁两栏
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student fills in a blank risk assessment form with two columns: a shield icon and a padlock icon.
shots.narration: 做风险评估时，
overlay: 风险评估，也评安保风险

shots.section_title: 风险评估，也评安保风险
shots.scene: 盾牌一栏打勾，锁一栏也在填
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: the shield column is checked and the padlock column is being filled in. No people.
shots.narration: 除了评意外，也要评被盗被滥用。

shots.section_title: 风险评估，也评安保风险
shots.scene: 钥匙、门卡、登记本三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a key, an access card and a logbook. No people.
shots.narration: 谁能进门，谁管钥匙，账怎么核。

shots.section_title: 风险评估，也评安保风险
shots.scene: 王老师在评估表上签字
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator reviews and signs the risk assessment form.
shots.narration: 评估结果交单位审核，定期复查。

shots.scene: 欣欣身旁浮现盾牌和锁
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside a floating shield and a floating padlock.
shots.narration: 安全防意外，安保防故意。

shots.scene: 培训、设备、门禁、登记四个图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons: a training class, a biosafety cabinet, an access card reader and a logbook. No people.
shots.narration: 规范操作守安全，门禁账目守安保。

shots.scene: 门卡被打叉，电话图标打勾
shots.prompt_en: A borrowed access card crossed out with a red X next to a phone icon with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 门卡不外借，可疑情况就报告。

shots.scene: 两排方向相反的台阶
shots.prompt_en: Two staircases with opposite danger arrows. No people.
shots.narration: 国内病原第一类最危险，别记反。

shots.scene: 阿杰收回门卡、关好门，和欣欣一起挥手
shots.prompt_en: The young male student closes the lab door, holds his own access card, and waves goodbye with the panda mascot.
shots.narration: 防意外，也防故意，下次见！
